title: Delhi SIR: SC to hear plea over EC's Form 6 clarification on Nov 19
description:
The Supreme Court on Wednesday said it would hear on November 19 concerns raised over the Election Commission's recent clarification allowing voters, whose names were omitted from the draft electoral rolls, to seek fresh enrolment through Form 6 during the special intensive revision of electoral rolls in Delhi.
Observing that people need not be apprehensive as the court was hearing the matter, a bench of Chief Justice Surya Kant and justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana asked petitioners Anjali Bharadwaj and Amrita Johri to file an appropriate application placing the EC's  November 3 clarification on record.
The bench said the matter would be taken up for hearing on November 19.
The CJI also indicated that the bench could consider asking the EC to extend the deadline, if necessary.
The issue was brought to the court's notice by advocate Prashant Bhushan, appearing for the petitioners.
